`2389.excalidraw.md` is the original minimal drawing attached by asmyers to
[issue #2389](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2389),
downloaded unchanged from the issue's
[attachment](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20846846/debug.excalidraw.md).
It contains a green rectangle and NBSP followed by a quotation mark. It is kept
separately from the generated CC0 seed; no CC0 license is asserted for this
reporter-supplied regression fixture.
